package externalconsumer

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/progresshans/godj/conformance/relationobjectproduct/blog"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/conformance/relationobjectproduct/project"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/db"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/orm"
)

func UseRelationObjects(backend db.Queryer, post blog.Post) error {
	objects, err := project.BindObjects()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	dynamic, err := objects.BlogPost.ParseDynamic(nil, []orm.LookupInput{
		{Key: "author__name", Value: "Ada"},
		{Key: "reviewer__isnull", Value: true},
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_ = blog.PostObjects.Using(backend).Filter(
		objects.BlogPost.Reviewer.IsNull(true),
		dynamic[0],
	)
	object, err := objects.BlogPost.From(backend, post)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err := object.Model(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err := object.Author(context.Background()); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, _, err := object.Reviewer(context.Background()); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = object.Fresh()
	return err
}
